# Recipes: every verified result and how to reproduce it

Speedups are paired timings with their 95 % CI, after the static checks and the full battery. LLM-benchmark
results are over the strongest amdclang build of the kernel; corpus results are over `amdclang -O3`.
`agc replay KERNEL` replays a session recipe; `apply`, `generate` and `relaunch` are session tools.

## Default-policy results (LLM benchmark)

One pass on the strongest amdclang build, no agent: `apply("baseline", pass, params)`.

| kernel | pass | speedup (95% CI) |
|---|---|---|
| `fi_merge_states` | `coarsen(factor=2)` | 1.050 (1.040 to 1.063) |
| `fi_rmsnorm` | `coarsen(factor=2)` | 1.044 (1.041 to 1.053) |
| `mo_glu_fwd` | `coarsen(factor=4)` | 1.056 (1.051 to 1.060) |
| `rb_copy` | `coarsen(factor=2)` | 1.027 (1.022 to 1.034) |
| `rb_dot` | `throttle(workgroups_per_cu=4)` | 1.026 (1.012 to 1.032) |
| `rb_nrm2` | `throttle(workgroups_per_cu=4)` | 1.032 (1.028 to 1.039) |
| `rb_rot` | `coarsen(factor=4)` | 1.025 (1.018 to 1.029) |
| `rb_scal` | `coarsen(factor=2)` | 1.063 (1.056 to 1.070) |

## Default-policy results (corpus, `tests/kernels`)

| kernel | pass or template | speedup (95% CI) |

| `axpy` | `coarsen(factor=2)` | 1.101 (1.098 to 1.104) |
| `cast_bf16` | `elementwise(elements_per_lane=4)` | 1.621 (1.609 to 1.633) |
| `gelu` | `elementwise(elements_per_lane=4)` | 1.682 (1.676 to 1.690) |
| `gemm_bf16` | `gemm_mfma(tiles=2, unroll=2)` | 203.845 (203.359 to 204.273) |
| `gemm_naive` | `unroll_loads(factor=16)` | 2.186 (2.183 to 2.190) |
| `layernorm` | `rowwise(unroll=4)` | 1.509 (1.505 to 1.513) |
| `matvec` | `unroll_loads(factor=16)` | 2.786 (2.780 to 2.795) |
| `rmsnorm` | `rowwise(unroll=4)` | 1.454 (1.448 to 1.458) |
| `row_sum` | `rowwise(unroll=4)` | 1.303 (1.287 to 1.311) |
| `softmax` | `rowwise(unroll=4)` | 1.345 (1.342 to 1.351) |

No verified win (fallback): `gemm_tiled`, `row_argmax`, `transpose`.

## GEMM on MFMA

C[M,N] = A[M,K] @ B[N,K]^T, bf16 inputs, f32 result; template `gemm_mfma`.

| shape | best parameters | TFLOP/s | over amdclang | hipBLASLt is faster by |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| square (4096 x 4096 x 4096) | {'tiles': 4, 'unroll': 2} | 479.2 | 417.8 | 2.65x |
| wide (2048 x 8192 x 4096) | {'tiles': 4, 'unroll': 2} | 475.3 | 414.1 | 2.57x |
| tall (8192 x 2048 x 4096) | {'tiles': 4, 'unroll': 2} | 474.5 | 412.4 | 2.72x |
| small (2048 x 2048 x 2048) | {'tiles': 2, 'unroll': 2} | 233.2 | 203.0 | 2.52x |
